authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13952 haḍḍa lists Oriya hāṛa, Hindi haḍḍī, Gujarati hāḍ and Marathi hāḍ bone; the addendum explicitly includes hāṛkɔ and hāḍkī. These bone forms fit that family, including k-extended forms. The remote connection to asthi is explicitly very doubtful. Exact survey form həɖikə is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12803.3 *kṣaṭ explicitly contains Punjabi che, Nepali cha, Oriya cha and Hindi/Gujarati cha; the addendum gives Jaunsari chau. These affricate six forms select section 3, not the ṣaṣ or *ṣuvaṭ branches. Exact survey form tʃe is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.
